hannover-lower-saxony-escapes-steinhuder.slogan: A 121 km loop out of Hannover north-west edge
hannover-lower-saxony-escapes-steinhuder.story: Water, small lanes and easy rhythm north-west of the city. Out of Garbsen-Mitte and back again: 121 km, roughly 2 h 28 in the saddle. scenicChapters.narrative: 34 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it — speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through.

scenicChapters.title: Rehburg hills → Mardorf lake road
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 13 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
